title: close deletes another sprint's empty worktree-agent branch, since nothing ties it to the sprint that made it
goal: clean_runner_leftovers counts a worktree-agent-* branch as the closed sprint's only when git worktree list --porcelain, read before any removal, shows its agent-<x> worktree on one of the sprint's work/<id> branches (BG-6a7jiylf's goal clause), and keeps any other with a close: kept line; a test plants two such branches, one tied to another sprint's work/<id>, and asserts that one is kept. Found by the SP-42bn4vz7 review of BG-6a7jiylf.

gates.question: Does close keep a worktree-agent branch whose agent worktree is already removed, or remove it when its tip is on main?
